sources.title: Afaan Oromoo TTS Model Development
sources.snippet: Afaan Oromoo TTS Model Development This thesis presents the development of a Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis model for Afaan Oromoo using a transformer neural network. The model enhances accessibility for Afaan Oromoo speakers by converting written text into spoken words, achieving high scores in naturalness and intelligibility.
